oneLine: Kissht parent OnEMI is considering a fresh fundraise following an 850 crore INR IPO.

sources.title: Kissht Parent OnEMI to Consider Fresh Fundraise After ₹850 Crore IPO

synopsis: OnEMI Technology Solutions, the parent company of digital lending platform Kissht, is considering raising fresh capital through an equity-linked fundraise, following an initial public offering that raised 850 crore INR in primary capital earlier in 2026. The company’s Board is scheduled to meet on September 17, 2026, to consider fundraising options which may include a preferential issue or private placement through equity shares, warrants, or convertible instruments. The final structure and size of the potential fundraise have not been disclosed.
